license_required.quote: No person shall: Engage in the practice of nursing or nurse assisting as defined in this act without a valid, current license, certificate or temporary permit

issuing_authority.quote: Board means the Wyoming state board of nursing

name.quote: Board means the Wyoming state board of nursing

type.quote: The board of nursing shall consist of seven (7) members to be appointed by the governor

degree_required.quote: Be a graduate of a state board approved nursing or nursing assistant education program recognized by the board which prepares the applicant for the level of licensure or certification being sought

exams.name: National nursing licensure or certification examination
exams.quote: Pass a board approved national nursing licensure or certification examination

interval_years.quote: Licenses or certificates issued under this act shall be renewed biennially according to a schedule established by board rules and regulations

required.quote: For licensees who have prescriptive authority the board shall require three (3) hours of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances or treatment of substance abuse disorders every two (2) years

hours_per_period.quote: three (3) hours of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances or treatment of substance abuse disorders every two (2) years

period_years.quote: three (3) hours of continuing education related to the responsible prescribing of controlled substances or treatment of substance abuse disorders every two (2) years

exists.quote: The board of nursing shall consist of seven (7) members to be appointed by the governor. Five (5) members shall be registered nurses, one (1) member shall be a licensed practical nurse and one (1) member shall be a representative of the public.

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall: Engage in the practice of nursing or nurse assisting as defined in this act without a valid, current license, certificate or temporary permit

credential_type.quote: License means a current document permitting the practice of nursing as an advanced practice registered nurse, registered nurse or licensed practical nurse

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall: Engage in the practice of nursing or nurse assisting as defined in this act without a valid, current license, certificate or temporary permit

title_protection.quote: No other person shall assume this title or use this abbreviation or any words, letters, signs or devices to indicate that the person using same is a registered professional nurse

scope_protection.quote: No person shall: Engage in the practice of nursing or nurse assisting as defined in this act without a valid, current license, certificate or temporary permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in any act inconsistent with uniform and reasonable standards of nursing practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act inconsistent with uniform and reasonable standards of nursing practice as defined by board rules and regulations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found guilty of or entered plea to misdemeanor or felony relating to nursing practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been found guilty by a court, has entered an Alford plea or has entered a plea of nolo contendere to a misdemeanor or felony that relates adversely to the practice of nursing or to the ability to practice nursing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced fraud or deceit in procuring license, filing health care information, signing reports, or representing authority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced fraud or deceit: In procuring or attempting to procure a license or certificate to practice nursing or nurse assisting; In filing or reporting any health care information, including but not limited to client documentation, agency records or other essential health documents; In signing any report or record as an advanced practice registered nurse, registered nurse, a licensed practical nurse or certified nursing assistant; In representing authority to practice nursing or nurse assisting; or In submitting any information or record to the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unfit or incompetent to practice nursing by reason of negligence, habits, physical or mental disability, or substance use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unfit or incompetent to practice nursing by reason of negligence, habits or other causes including but not limited to: Being unable to practice nursing with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of physical or mental disability, or use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals or any other mind-altering material; or Performance of unsafe nursing practice or failure to conform to the essential standards of acceptable and prevailing nursing practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in unauthorized possession or use of controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any unauthorized possession or unauthorized use of a controlled substance as defined in the Wyoming Controlled Substances Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Had license denied, revoked, suspended or restricted in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has had a license or certificate to practice nursing or nurse assisting or to practice in another health care discipline in another jurisdiction, territory or possession of the United States denied, revoked, suspended or otherwise restricted

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced nursing without valid current license or temporary permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced nursing or nurse assisting within this state without a valid current license or temporary permit or as otherwise permitted under this act, the Nurse Licensure Compact or the Advanced Practice Registered Nurse Compact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly and willfully failed to report violations to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly and willfully failed to report to the board any violation of this act or of board rules and regulations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated any provisions of the act or board rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been found by the board to have violated any of the provisions of this act or of board rules and regulations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly engaged in act beyond scope of practice or performed acts without sufficient education or ability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has knowingly engaged in an act which the licensee or certificate holder knew was beyond the scope of the individual's nursing or nurse assisting practice prior to committing the act, or performed acts without sufficient education, knowledge or ability to apply nursing principles and skills

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to submit to mental, physical or medical competency examination when requested
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to submit to a mental, physical or medical competency examination following a proper request by the board made pursuant to board rules and regulations and the Wyoming Administrative Procedure Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violated a previously entered board order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has violated a previously entered board order

definition_quote.value: Practice of professional nursing means the performance of professional services requiring substantial knowledge of the biological, physical, behavioral, psychological and sociological sciences, and of nursing theory as the basis for applying the nursing process which consists of assessment, diagnosis, planning, intervention and evaluation. The nursing process is utilized in the promotion and maintenance of health, case finding and management of illness, injury or infirmity, restoration of optimum function and achievement of a dignified death. Nursing practice includes but is not limited to administration, teaching, counseling, supervision, delegation, evaluation of nursing practice and execution of the medical regimen.

drug_authority.value: May administer medications and treatments prescribed by any person authorized by state law to prescribe
drug_authority.quote: The therapeutic plan includes the administration of medications and treatments prescribed by any person authorized by state law to prescribe

license_tiers.quote: License means a current document permitting the practice of nursing as an advanced practice registered nurse, registered nurse or licensed practical nurse

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: These skills and services are performed under the direction of a licensed physician or dentist, advanced practice registered nurse or registered professional nurse

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: An APRN issued a multistate license is authorized to assume responsibility and accountability for patient care independent of a supervisory or collaborative relationship with a physician

full_independent_practice_available.quote: An APRN issued a multistate license is authorized to assume responsibility and accountability for patient care independent of a supervisory or collaborative relationship with a physician

controlled_substance_schedule_authority.quote: May prescribe, administer, dispense or provide nonprescriptive and prescriptive medications including prepackaged medications, except schedule I drugs as defined in W.S. 35-7-1013 and 35-7-1014

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: By board rule and regulation, regulate the qualifications, certification, recertification, examination and discipline of nursing assistants and nurse aides

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: The nursing assistant/nurse aide shall complete a specified course of study approved by the board, meet minimum competency requirements and be certified by the board

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: Hospitals, nursing homes and other employers of advanced practice registered nurses, registered nurses, licensed practical nurses and certified nursing assistants shall report to the board the names of those licensees or certificate holders whose employment has been terminated voluntarily or involuntarily for any reasons stipulated in W.S. 33-21-146

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The Nurse Licensure Compact is enacted into law and entered into on behalf of this state with all other states legally joining in the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: A multistate license to practice registered or licensed practical/vocational nursing issued by a home state to a resident in that state will be recognized by each party state as authorizing a nurse to practice as a registered nurse (RN) or as a licensed practical/vocational nurse (LPN/VN), under a multistate licensure privilege, in each party state
